description: July 25 birthday meaning: Leo decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 25 birthday falls in Leo, in the first decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: The July 25 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Leo's Sun-ruled first decan meets the reflective number 7 on July 25th. Two degrees into the sign, the Lion's confidence turns slightly inward: pride in craft, in mastery, in knowing a subject properly. Interpretive traditions describe a dignified, thoughtful performer who prefers being respected to being merely noticed, and who needs time alone to recharge.

Astronomically, July 25 puts the Sun near 2° Leo in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Sun. With the Sun ruling both the sign and its first decan, late-July birthdays sit in the most radiant part of Leo. This is traditionally the decan of presence: warmth, self-expression and a natural pull towards the centre of the stage or the head of the table. Generosity and loyalty are often strong, and so is a need to be appreciated for the effort behind the performance. The doubled solar tone can tip into wounded pride when recognition is withheld. These Lions usually shine brightest when their light is used to warm a whole group rather than only to illuminate themselves.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for July 25
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a July 25 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous July 25 birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 25 is the 206th day of the year (207th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Virgo, is usually complete within 29 days, by August 23.

By July 25 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a July 25 birthday are Rosalind Franklin (1920), Elias Canetti (1905) and Gavrilo Princip (1894).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 25?
faq.answer: July 25 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Leo, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 25 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 25?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 25, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 25?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on July 25 include Rosalind Franklin (1920), Elias Canetti (1905) and Gavrilo Princip (1894). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
